transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… my eating’s been off. Some days I just forget lunch altogether, and then other days I’m standing there eating crackers or sweets, even though nothing really tastes right. It’s been bothering me.
Do you find that you don’t enjoy eating as much as you used to, or that food doesn’t taste good even when you eat it?
Yeah… I guess I don’t enjoy it much. Food just doesn’t taste right, even when I do eat. Some days I forget lunch, and other days I just pick at crackers or sweets at the counter.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

My appetite’s been… uneven, I guess. Some days I forget lunch completely. Other days I just end up eating crackers or sweets at the counter, even though it doesn’t really taste right. As for weight, I’m not sure.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days lately?
Most mornings, yes… I wake up feeling kind of heavy and low. Like the day’s already gone dull before I even get dressed.
Have you been feeling more tired or low on energy lately, even if you’re getting enough sleep?
I’m not really sure. I feel slow some mornings, but I don’t know if it’s tiredness exactly. It’s hard to tell.
Have you been having trouble focusing on tasks or making decisions lately?
Yes… some. I’ll sit there looking at something simple, like the mail or thinking I should call the pharmacy, and I just get foggy. Then I don’t do either one.
Have you been having trouble thinking clearly or concentrating on things lately?
Yes… I guess so. I’ll just sit there staring at something simple, like the mail, or wondering if I should call the pharmacy first, and my mind gets foggy. Then I end up not doing either.
Has it been harder lately to think clearly or focus on even simple tasks, like reading or making a phone call?
Yes… I think so. I’ll just sit there with something simple, like the mail or whether I should call the pharmacy, and my head gets foggy. Then I don’t really do either one.
How long have you been feeling this way, with the low mood and difficulty focusing on tasks?
It’s been… a long while. Maybe about a year and a couple months, that low, dull feeling and the trouble getting my mind to settle on things.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with others?
Yes… I used to go to watercolor class, and there was a quilting circle, book club too. I still pack the bag sometimes, but it just sits by the door. I can’t seem to care enough to go.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or that you’re letting others down, even when there’s no clear reason for it?
I don’t know… not really in a clear way. I just feel low, mostly. I haven’t thought about it like I’m not worth anything.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or have trouble sitting still, like your body feels restless or weighed down?

Yes… I guess slowed down, mostly. Little things take longer now, like crossing the room or buttoning my sweater. Sometimes I do pace a bit, carrying the same papers around, but… mostly I feel weighed down.
Have you had periods in the past where you felt this same kind of low mood, or has this been the only time you've felt this way?
It’s… been this way a long time now. Maybe about a year and a couple months. Just that same low, gray sort of feeling.
Have you had episodes of low mood like this before, or is this the first time you’ve felt this way over a longer period?
I think this is the long stretch… it’s been about a year and two months, that same dull, colorless feeling.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt this low for a couple of weeks or more, even before this past year and two months?
I don’t know about before… not like this, I guess. Lately, most mornings I wake up already feeling heavy and low, like the day’s gone dull before I even get dressed.
